You may read, print forms, complete them and deliver them to the nearest Riceland facility or mail them to the address provided on the form.
Internet account access agreement
Read and agree to receive a password and access account information.
Download Form
membership agreement
To participate in the benefits of Riceland membership.
Download Form
marketing agreement
To authorize the cooperative to market grain you deliver.
Download Form
Rice delivery agreement
To be assured that the cooperative will receive and market your rice (submit annually). Please visit your local drier to fill out the Rice Delivery Agreement and to talk about the changes made to the Rice Marketing program.
Download Form
SUPPLEMENTAL MARKETING AGREEMENT WITH HELD FUNDS
Read and agree to receive a password and access account information.
Download Form
DIRECT DEPOSIT AUTHORIZATION AGREEMENT
To participate in Direct Deposit payment program.
Download Form
CHECK – LOSS GUARANTEE
To stop payment on a check for crop proceeds or capital refunds that is considered lost or destroyed.
Download Form
IRS W-9
Riceland is required to report income to the IRS which must include your taxpayer identification number.
Download Form
Retiree Equity Redemption Program Application
If you are no longer engaged in farming and not delivering commodities to Riceland or any other marketing organization, you may apply for redemption of equity.
Download Form
Semi-Retiree Equity Redemption Program Application
Farmer-members who are no longer engaged in active farming, but who have commodities delivered reflecting crop rent, may apply for redemption of excess equity (Base Capital).
Download Form
AUTHORIZATION OF CAPITAL TRANSFER
To transfer Riceland Base Capital and Class A Stock to any family member.
Download Form
Change of Address Form
To prevent delays in receiving important information from Riceland, complete a Change of Address form should your mailing address change.
Download Form
FOOD BANK CONTRIBUTION FORM
To designate a quantity of rice to the Arkansas Rice Depot or the Missouri Bootheel Food Bank for distribution to the needy.
Download Form
Riceland PAC Contribution
To contribute to the Riceland PAC (Political Action Committee) that supports federal candidates.
Download Form
Request for GROWERS’ OPTION RICE PARTIAL ADVANCE
To request an advance on long grain rice in Grower's Option.
Download Form
Certificate of eligibility for rice
For CCC marketing gain benefits
